title: Motion transfer from a driving video
description: Kling Motion Control / Genjutsu / Seedance reference video: the video carries the motion, the prompt holds 3-5 context points.

body.subject: This character, exactly as in [start_image]: {{design_lock}}.
body.action: He performs the motion shown in [video_reference].
body.camera: Match the framing of [video_reference], full body in frame on both sides.
body.style: Plain grid studio floor, even light.
body.constraints: Keep the character's scale and facing matched to the performer; full body in frame.

design_lock.default: dark bronze plate armour, gold lion-head pauldrons, crimson cloth skirt with a gold meander hem, black undersuit
design_lock.description: what must stay unchanged: the design in words

start_image.description: the character image; its scale and facing match the performer

bytedance/seedance*.note: names references in prose; roles are start_image / end_image / video references

higgsfield/*.note: Higgsfield media roles: start_image, end_image, image_references, video_references

heygen/*.note: audio is always on and not controllable; only a first frame is taken

provenance.note: precondition: the character scale and facing match the performer, run a 5 s test before the full length
